paper.title: Accurate Computation of Quantum Excited States with Neural Networks
paper.authors: David Pfau, Simon Axelrod, Halvard Sutterud, Ingrid von Glehn, James S. Spencer

results.system_description: Li atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 2 up and 1 down electrons
results.source_location: Table (tab:atomic_spectra), Li, first row (ground state), NES-VMC Energy column 'FermiNet k=5'
results.eligibility_evidence: Ground-state energy of natural excited states VMC (NES-VMC): the lowest eigenvalue of the K x K local-energy matrix of the K-state ansatz, an upper bound to E_0 (Hylleraas-Undheim-MacDonald); the paper's own runs, eligible under P5 (2026-11-02).
results.notes: N_up = 2, N_down = 1: the only sector of the 2S ground term with N_up >= N_down; not printed. Atom at the origin, all electrons. The error of each state is propagated from the covariance of the local-energy matrix (appendix, 'Variance Estimation'); its meaning is not stated further. The excited-state rows and the experimental columns are not entries.

results.system_description: Ethene at the geometry 'Barbatti torsion 0 deg', all electrons, 8 up and 8 down electrons, clamped nuclei
results.source_location: Table (tab:ethene), row 'tau=0, k=5', first state, FermiNet 'Energy (Ha)' column
results.eligibility_evidence: Ground-state energy of natural excited states VMC (NES-VMC): the lowest eigenvalue of the K x K local-energy matrix of the K-state ansatz, an upper bound to E_0 (Hylleraas-Undheim-MacDonald); the paper's own runs, eligible under P5 (2026-11-02).
results.notes: Geometry: the planar ethylene of Barbatti, Paier and Lischka (2004), printed in arXiv:2203.09472v3 Supplementary Table I, with the torsion angle tau varied 'while keeping all other geometric parameters fixed' (2203.09472v3, Results): the CH2 group on the +x carbon is rotated rigidly about the C-C axis, as in the code release of Pfau et al. (google-deepmind/ferminet, ferminet/configs/excited/twisted_ethylene.py) and the parametrized table of arXiv:2503.19847v2 (tab:ethylen_geom); coordinates rounded to 1e-6 angstrom. Singlet, N_up = N_down = 8. The paper uses 'the geometry from previous studies' (Barbatti 2004) and its code release builds exactly this rotation (electrons (8, 8)). The same table prints <S^2> between 0.001 and 0.003 for the ground state. The error of each state is propagated from the covariance of the local-energy matrix (appendix, 'Variance Estimation'); its meaning is not stated further. At tau = 0 the table gives both a K = 5 and a K = 3 run; both are recorded.

(google-deepmind/ferminet, ferminet/configs/excited/twisted_ethylene.py) and the parametrized table of arXiv:2503.19847v2 (tab:ethylen_geom); coordinates rounded to 1e-6 angstrom.
